The Postgraduation must be of a minimum 2-year full-time duration from a recognised University/Institution. Minimum 55% aggregate marks or equivalent Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) in both Graduation and Post-Graduation. | Candidates must have a minimum of 2 years of post-qualification experience in Banks, Financial Institutions, or Upper Layer NBFCs, in the areas of marketing of products and services for Corporate Loans Syndication, Corporate Credit, etc.

salary_details.details: The compensation for the post of Business Development Officer is Rs. 14.68 lakh per annum, with annual increments for candidates having two years of work experience. The compensation structure comprises fixed and variable components in the ratio of 80:20. The compensation may increase as per the Bank's pay matrix for candidates having more work experience.

selection_process: Selection for the post of Business Development Officer is based on shortlisting followed by a personal interview; there is no written examination specified in the notification.
Application Screening: The Bank will check whether applicants meet all the prescribed eligibility criteria relating to qualification
and age. Shortlisting for Interview: Candidates will be shortlisted for interviews in the ratio of 1:10. If more than 10 eligible candidates are found for the available posts

a shortlist will be drawn based on the percentage score obtained at the post-graduation examination. Personal Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be called for a personal interview at the Bank's office in Mumbai or New Delhi. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed; no correspondence will be made with ineligible or non-shortlisted candidates.
how_to_apply: Exim Bank Business Development Officer Apply process is entirely through email; there is no online application portal specified in the notification.
Download and fill the Application Format for Officer (On Contract Basis) – Business Development Officer, as attached with the official notice.
Fill in Personal Details: Name, Date of Birth, Nationality, Category, Email ID, Mobile Number, and Correspondence Address.

Complete the Education and Professional Qualification section for Graduation, Post-Graduation, and any other qualification, including name of college/university, year of passing, and percentage of marks.
Fill the Career Summary section, starting with the latest/present employment, covering company name, position/designation, tenure, location, and key responsibilities.

Complete the Additional Information section: Current CTC, Expected CTC, Notice Period, and declarations regarding conviction, ongoing criminal/disciplinary proceedings, and relationship with any Bank employee.
Sign the Declaration confirming that all information provided is true and correct.
Attach a recent photograph in the space provided on the application format.
Email the completed application/resume to [email protected] with the subject line: "BDO Application: Mr./ Ms. (Full Name)", before October 25, 2026.
important_instructions: Candidates are requested to check their eligibility carefully before sending their resumes, as no correspondence will be made with ineligible candidates. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed regarding the interview; candidates not shortlisted will not receive any communication. Where more than 10 eligible candidates are available against the posts, shortlisting for interview will be based on the percentage score obtained at the post-graduation examination. The Bank may relax eligibility criteria relating to experience, age, and essential qualifications at its discretion in case of a limited response or insufficient number of eligible candidates. Candidates must declare any prior conviction by a court of law, ongoing criminal/disciplinary proceedings, and any relationship with an existing Bank employee in the application format. Furnishing false information in the application may lead to disqualification from the recruitment process.

content_sections.heading: Exim Bank Business Development Officer Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Exim Bank BDO eligibility 2026 is based on educational qualification, academic marks, and relevant post-qualification work experience, along with the prescribed age limit. Postgraduate in Marketing/Finance, preferably MBA with specialization in Finance or Marketing. The Postgraduation must be of a minimum 2-year full-time duration from a recognised University/Institution. Minimum 55% aggregate marks or equivalent Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) in both Graduation and Post-Graduation. Candidates must have a minimum of 2 years of post-qualification experience in Banks, Financial Institutions, or Upper Layer NBFCs, in the areas of marketing of products and services for Corporate Loans Syndication, Corporate Credit, etc.

content_sections.heading: Exim Bank Business Development Officer Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The candidate should not be more than 35 years of age as on August 31, 2026. Reservations in the upper age limit are applicable as per prevailing Government of India (GoI) guidelines; specific category-wise age relaxation figures are not specified in the notification. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: Exim Bank Business Development Officer Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The compensation for the post of Business Development Officer is Rs. 14.68 lakh per annum , with annual increments for candidates having two years of work experience. The compensation structure comprises fixed and variable components in the ratio of 80:20 . The compensation may increase as per the Bank's pay matrix for candidates having more work experience.

content_sections.heading: Exim Bank Business Development Officer Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection for the post of Business Development Officer is based on shortlisting followed by a personal interview; there is no written examination specified in the notification. Application Screening: The Bank will check whether applicants meet all the prescribed eligibility criteria relating to qualification, experience, and age. Shortlisting for Interview: Candidates will be shortlisted for interviews in the ratio of 1:10. If more than 10 eligible candidates are found for the available posts, a shortlist will be drawn based on the percentage score obtained at the post-graduation examination. Personal Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be called for a personal interview at the Bank's office in Mumbai or New Delhi. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed; no correspondence will be made with ineligible or non-shortlisted candidates.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Exim Bank Business Development Officer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Exim Bank Business Development Officer Apply process is entirely through email; there is no online application portal specified in the notification. Download and fill the Application Format for Officer (On Contract Basis) – Business Development Officer, as attached with the official notice. Fill in Personal Details: Name, Date of Birth, Nationality, Category, Email ID, Mobile Number, and Correspondence Address. Complete the Education and Professional Qualification section for Graduation, Post-Graduation, and any other qualification, including name of college/university, year of passing, and percentage of marks. Fill the Career Summary section, starting with the latest/present employment, covering company name, position/designation, tenure, location, and key responsibilities. Complete the Additional Information section: Current CTC, Expected CTC, Notice Period, and declarations regarding conviction, ongoing criminal/disciplinary proceedings, and relationship with any Bank employee. Sign the Declaration confirming that all information provided is true and correct. Attach a recent photograph in the space provided on the application format. Email the completed application/resume to [email protected] with the subject line: "BDO Application: Mr./ Ms. (Full Name)" , before October 25, 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is Exim Bank Business Development Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a notice issued by the Export-Import Bank of India (Exim Bank) inviting applications for recruitment of Officers on Contract Basis for the position of Business Development Officer, for a total of 12 posts across 11 cities in India.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Exim Bank Business Development Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 12 vacancies have been announced (UR-7, OBC (NCL)-3, SC-1, EWS-1), across Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Chandigarh, Chennai, Hyderabad, Indore, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mumbai (2 posts), New Delhi, and Pune.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Exim Bank Business Development Officer 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is October 25, 2026. Eligible candidates must email their resume to [email protected] before this date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Exim Bank Business Development Officer?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Postgraduate degree in Marketing/Finance, preferably an MBA with specialization in Finance or Marketing, of minimum 2-year full-time duration, with at least 55% aggregate marks/equivalent CGPA in both Graduation and Post-Graduation.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Exim Bank Business Development Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The candidate should not be more than 35 years of age as on August 31, 2026. Reservations in age limit apply as per prevailing GoI guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the experience required for Exim Bank Business Development Officer?
faq.answer: A minimum of 2 years of post-qualification experience in Banks, Financial Institutions, or Upper Layer NBFCs in marketing of products and services for Corporate Loans Syndication, Corporate Credit, etc. is required.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for Exim Bank Business Development Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must fill the prescribed Application Format and email it as their resume to [email protected] with the subject line "BDO Application: Mr./ Ms. (Full Name)" before October 25, 2026. There is no online application portal.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Exim Bank Business Development Officer?
faq.answer: Selection is based on shortlisting (in the ratio of 1:10, based on post-graduation percentage if more than 10 candidates are eligible) followed by a personal interview at the Bank's office in Mumbai or New Delhi. There is no written examination specified.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for Exim Bank Business Development Officer?
faq.answer: The compensation is Rs. 14.68 lakh per annum, with fixed and variable components in the ratio of 80:20, and annual increments for candidates with two years of work experience.
